context:
Static disclosure - no new data fetching required. All the displayed
fields come from the detail result object already loaded by ResultDetail.
The panel is a simple definition list rendered from props.

Collapsed by default with a clear "How this was measured ↓" label.
The label should be visible on first load so the panel is discoverable.
description:
Post-launch audit (2026-04-14) found that a visitor to a result detail
page cannot determine:
  - What the "Duration" number means (sum? mean? median?)
  - Whether tuning was applied (currently just a boolean)
  - Whether warmup queries are included in the timing
  - What execution mode was used (SQL vs DataFrame)
  - What hardware the result was produced on beyond OS/arch/CPU count

This matters because BenchBox's differentiator over ClickBench is
"rich per-query detail - execution plans, tuning configurations,
validation status". If a visitor can't interpret the numbers, that
claim is hollow. The absence of methodology disclosure also makes it
impossible to assess whether two results are meaningfully comparable.

This TODO adds a "How this was measured" disclosure section to the
ResultDetail page that surfaces the aggregation method, execution mode,
tuning state, test type, and key environment parameters.

anti_patterns.dont: add interactive filtering or controls to the disclosure panel

anti_patterns.instead: disclosure is for the methodologically curious
anti_patterns.why: most visitors just want the numbers
'Geomean query time' is not obvious to a first-time visitor

preserves.behavior: Collapsed by default - visitors who don't care are not burdened
Existing ResultDetail layout above the disclosure panel - disclosure is additive
Graceful rendering for bundles that lack execution_mode / tuning_mode (null-safe)

verifications.description: Component renders for null execution_mode (old bundle compatibility)

work_units.notes:
Metric definition copy: "Primary metric is geometric mean of per-query
execution times (measurement runs only). Wall-clock total is shown
separately. Lower geomean = faster."

Test type: "Power test (single-stream sequential)" or "Throughput test
(N concurrent streams)".

Query scope: "Full benchmark (22 queries)" or "Query subset: Q1, Q6, Q17".

Environment: already surfaced (OS/arch/CPU/memory/Python). Add
execution_mode and tuning_mode here too.
work_units.summary: Design the disclosure panel content: list each disclosed item (metric definition, execution mode, tuning mode, test type, query scope, environment summary) and write the copy for each.
Implement MethodologyDisclosure component in results-explorer/src/components/. Collapsible panel, collapsed by default. Accepts detail result props; renders the disclosed items as a definition list.
Integrate MethodologyDisclosure into ResultDetail.tsx below the query timing table. Ensure it renders for all bundles including those predating the extended manifest (graceful null handling).
Add comparability summary row to Compare.tsx header: execution_mode + tuning_mode + test_type per result. Surfaces differences without navigating to detail pages.
